From 077cdda764c7f147e03e6065ba0cd1dbc1bf00d1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Roi Dayan <roid@nvidia.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Dec 2021 09:20:58 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] net/mlx5e: TC, Fix memory leak with rules with internal port

Fix a memory leak with decap rule with internal port as destination
device. The driver allocates a modify hdr action but doesn't set
the flow attr modify hdr action which results in skipping releasing
the modify hdr action when releasing the flow.

    [<000000005f8c651c>] krealloc+0x83/0xd0
    [<000000009f59b143>] alloc_mod_hdr_actions+0x156/0x310 [mlx5_core]

    [<00000000b44ea75a>] mlx5e_tc_add_fdb_flow+0x962/0x1470 [mlx5_core]
    [<0000000003e384a0>] __mlx5e_add_fdb_flow+0x54c/0xb90 [mlx5_core]
    [<00000000ed8b22b6>] mlx5e_configure_flower+0xe45/0x4af0 [mlx5_core]
    [<00000000024f4ab5>] mlx5e_rep_indr_offload.isra.0+0xfe/0x1b0 [mlx5_core]
    [<000000006c3bb494>] mlx5e_rep_indr_setup_tc_cb+0x90/0x130 [mlx5_core]
    [<00000000d3dac2ea>] tc_setup_cb_add+0x1d2/0x420

Fixes: b16eb3c81fe2 ("net/mlx5: Support internal port as decap route device")
Signed-off-by: Roi Dayan <roid@nvidia.com>
Signed-off-by: Saeed Mahameed <saeedm@nvidia.com>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/en_tc.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/en_tc.c
index a60c7680fd2b..5e454a14428f 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/en_tc.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/en_tc.c
@@ -1441,6 +1441,8 @@ mlx5e_tc_add_fdb_flow(struct mlx5e_priv *priv,
 							metadata);
 			if (err)
 				goto err_out;
+
+			attr->action |= MLX5_FLOW_CONTEXT_ACTION_MOD_HDR;
 		}
 	}
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/en_tc.c`**
   - A new line of code was added to set the `attr->action` to include `MLX5_FLOW_CONTEXT_ACTION_MOD_HDR` when a modify header action is allocated. This change ensures that the flow attribute correctly reflects the allocation of the modify header action.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `en_tc.c` addresses a memory leak issue that arises when a decap rule is created with an internal port as the destination device. By ensuring that the flow attribute's modify header action is set, the patch prevents the driver from skipping the release of the modify header action during flow cleanup, thus resolving the memory leak. This change is directly related to the previously introduced functionality that allowed internal ports to be used as decap route devices, as indicated by the fix reference to commit `b16eb3c81fe2`.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
attr->action |= MLX5_FLOW_CONTEXT_ACTION_MOD_HDR;
```
Reason:
The driver allocates a modify header action but does not set the corresponding flow attribute for the modify header action. This omission results in the allocated modify header action not being properly released when the flow is released, leading to a memory leak.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
attr->action |= MLX5_FLOW_CONTEXT_ACTION_MOD_HDR;
```
Reason:
By ensuring that the flow attribute for the modify header action is set correctly, the patch allows the system to recognize the allocated modify header action during the flow release process, thus preventing the memory leak.
